$comment: Country cards: the country name set in the card template (Paper, UI page, 'Country / …') over a pixel-art strip of one city. `code` is the ISO code used by data/places.json; `cityId` is the gazetteer city the artwork draws. Curators and scenes join a card through their placeId's country, at build. Landmarks read left to right along one baseline; the palette names real things in that city. scripts/lib/place-art.mjs supplies the constant style block. A `list` makes the card a list too: the build turns it into playlist pl_country-<slug> (title = country, the curator named, local artists pinned first, the rest filled from its genres) with the exported card as its cover. A card with no key in data/artwork.json is the next batch: `npm run countries -- --missing`.

countries.name: United States
landmarks: a brownstone row with fire escapes and a wooden water tower on the roof
one granite arch of a suspension bridge with its fan of cables
an art-deco skyscraper with a stepped crown and a thin spire, rising into the sky
a yellow taxi at the kerb
countries.palette: brownstone rust, limestone cream, taxi yellow, Hudson grey-blue, bridge granite, pale haze sky

list.note: Philadelphia to Portland by way of every basement with a piano in it. Mostly what I play a friend who says they do not like jazz.

countries.name: Spain
landmarks: a row of palm trees on the beach promenade
a modernista house with a wavy balcony facade and a scaled mosaic roof
the spires of a great unfinished basilica with a crane beside it, rising into the sky
terracotta rooftops stepping down to the sea
countries.palette: sandstone ochre, trencadís turquoise, terracotta, Mediterranean blue, palm green, whitewash

list.note: Barcelona at seven in the morning, when the clubs let out onto the beach. I go every June and come back with this.

countries.name: Mexico
landmarks: jacaranda trees in full violet bloom
a marble palace with an amber tiled dome
a tall column topped by a small golden winged figure, rising into the sky
a pink modernist wall, a volcano faint on the horizon
countries.palette: jacaranda violet, palace marble, dome amber, angel gold, tezontle red, Barragán pink

list.note: My city the way it sounds from a rooftop in Roma Norte. Antonella Iriarte opens it because she is the reason I moved back.

countries.name: Japan
landmarks: a five-storey pagoda with slate roofs
a vermilion torii gate
cherry trees in blossom along a canal
a red and white lattice broadcast tower rising into the sky, Mount Fuji faint and snow-capped far behind
countries.palette: torii vermilion, sakura pink, Fuji snow white, slate roof blue-grey, moss green, pale sky

list.note: Tokyo after the last train. Ren Ishii and Redshift are from here; the rest is what I hear in the taxi home.

countries.name: Argentina
landmarks: corrugated tin houses painted in patchwork colours, a balcony with washing
a tall white obelisk rising into the sky
a white cable-stayed footbridge with one leaning mast over the docks
a jacaranda and a city bus
countries.palette: tin red, Caminito yellow, celeste, obelisk white, river brown-grey, plane-tree green

list.note: Buenos Aires is a three-hour flight and a completely different Sunday. Mateo Molinari first, always.

countries.name: Chile
landmarks: the snow-capped Andes as a wall across the whole horizon
a hill with a small white statue on its summit
one very tall glass tower rising into the sky
an adobe colonial church and a thin river channel
countries.palette: Andes snow, sierra violet-brown, copper, glass teal, adobe cream, pale dry sky

list.note: Santiago has the Andes at the end of every street, and bands that play like they know it. Start with I.A.R.

countries.name: Brazil
landmarks: a museum box of glass lifted on two bright red concrete beams, open plaza beneath
a curving high-rise with wavy horizontal concrete bands, rising into the sky
a yellow ipê tree in bloom
a painted graffiti wall and palms
countries.palette: museum red, concrete grey, ipê yellow, deep leaf green, graffiti pink and teal, hazy sky

list.note: Home. São Paulo is concrete and rain and somebody’s speaker on a balcony; this is what is usually coming out of it.

countries.name: France
landmarks: cream limestone apartment blocks with zinc mansard roofs and chimney pots
a café awning on the corner
a stone bridge over the river with green bookstall boxes on the quay
a bronze iron lattice tower rising into the sky
countries.palette: limestone cream, zinc blue-grey, tower bronze, Seine green-grey, awning red, chestnut green

list.note: Paris is not all house music, whatever my other lists say. Margot & The Spindles and Lodestar live twenty minutes from me.

countries.name: Ghana
landmarks: a red and white striped lighthouse rising into the sky
a monumental ceremonial arch with a star on top
painted wooden fishing canoes pulled up on the sand
coconut palms and low surf
countries.palette: kente gold, forest green, clay red, Atlantic teal, sand, lighthouse white

list.note: Accra on a Friday: highlife on the radio, afrobeat from the car next to you, dub from somewhere you cannot see.

countries.name: Norway
landmarks: a white marble opera house whose roof slopes down into the water
a city hall of two plain square red-brick towers
wooden houses in ochre and ox-red
pine hills with a ski jump on the ridge, a small sailboat on the fjord
countries.palette: marble white, fjord blue, ox-red, ochre, pine green, pale northern sky

list.note: Oslo in the blue hour, which in winter is most of the afternoon. Rasmus, Halvor and Zoning & Census are all neighbours.

countries.name: United Kingdom
landmarks: a gothic clock tower rising into the sky
a red double-decker bus on a bridge over the river
a terrace of brick houses with chimney pots
a plane tree and a taxi
countries.palette: stock brick, bus red, Portland stone, Thames grey-green, slate, pale overcast sky

countries.name: Germany
landmarks: a slim television tower with a silver sphere rising into the sky
a red brick double-deck bridge with turrets and a yellow train on top
a pre-war apartment block with a painted mural on its side wall
a sandstone gate with columns
countries.palette: brick red, U-Bahn yellow, sphere silver, Spree grey-blue, sandstone, linden green

countries.name: Colombia
landmarks: a green mountain ridge with a white church on its summit
red brick residential towers
a colonial street of whitewashed houses with coloured doors and wooden balconies
wax palms
countries.palette: Andes green, brick red, whitewash, door cobalt, balcony ochre, cloud grey

countries.name: Nigeria
landmarks: a long low bridge across a lagoon
yellow minibuses in a row
a cluster of glass towers on the island rising into the sky
a market of striped umbrellas
countries.palette: danfo yellow, lagoon teal, laterite red, market indigo, palm green, humid white sky

countries.name: Australia
landmarks: a yellow railway station with a green copper dome and a row of clocks
a green and yellow tram
a laneway wall covered in paint
a gum tree on the river bank
countries.palette: station ochre, copper verdigris, tram green, eucalyptus grey-green, river brown, bright pale sky

countries.name: Serbia
landmarks: a stone fortress wall on a green hill above two meeting rivers
a white domed church rising into the sky
a moored river barge
a modernist tower with a revolving top
countries.palette: fortress limestone, Danube green-grey, dome white, copper green, rust, pale summer sky
